import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(scanner);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static void solve(Scanner scanner) {
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextLong();
        }
        long k = scanner.nextLong();
        Arrays.sort(a);
        long ma = 0;
        long cnt = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) {
            for (int i = j + 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (a[i] - a[j] <= k) {
                    cnt++;
                } else {
                    ma = Math.max(ma, cnt);
                    cnt = 1;
                }
            }
            ma = Math.max(ma, cnt);
            cnt = 1;
        }
        System.out.println(Math.max(ma, cnt));
    }
}
